_policy: Estimate the population median of balanced ABBA geometric ratios for each of twelve batch-mean and batch-mean-P99 metrics. Use the exact binomial median interval with Bonferroni control over 24 statistics; under iid block ratios, 64 blocks select ranks 20 and 45 and give at least 96.2493% joint coverage. Fixed sample size and orientation seed are declared before new controls/candidate runs, with no optional stopping or outlier deletion. Keep all raw runs, maximum cross-pair envelopes and repeated-baseline variation as diagnostics. The 10% regression limit and all historical absolute ceilings are unchanged. Previous short/envelope pilots remain inconclusive; they are not relabeled. Independent A-A and actual +20% wall-clock-delay binary controls must qualify the measurement before candidate acceptance. Controls do not prove iid or sensitivity to a 10% algorithm regression.
